text.en: Gopu, Simmi and Raj walk to school and see plants of many sizes and shapes: tiny, small, large, bushy, thin and tall.

Gopu, Simmi and Raj walk to school every day and notice so many kinds of plants.
Plants come in different sizes and shapes: very tiny, small, large, bushy, thin and curvy, straight and tall.
Trees have a big trunk of wood and many branches with leaves. Their roots go deep into the soil. Mango, coconut, banyan, peepal and jackfruit are trees.
Shrubs are medium-sized plants with several woody stems and branches. The tulsi plant at home is a shrub.
Herbs are small plants with soft green stems.
Some plants are climbers and creepers and need support to grow up (additional, not in the textbook).
Write the names of trees you can recognise and where you have seen them.
